title: Provider profiles
description: Every provider profile in the company.

help.title: About Provider profiles
help.overview: A provider profile is a user's seller record on the marketplace: bio, skills, portfolio, weekly availability, reputation, and the Stripe Connect account that receives payouts. Each user has at most one live profile.

sections.title: Profile fields
items: Bio, skills, and portfolio describe the provider on the storefront.
Availability is a list of weekly slots: day of week, start time, and end time.
Reputation is computed, not typed: the average rating of reviews on all their orders, and the share of finished orders that completed rather than being cancelled.

sections.title: Where profiles are edited
items: This page lists every provider profile in the company; a new one asks which user it belongs to.
Each user also edits their own under Settings → Provider profile, where it opens straight as a form.

sections.title: Payouts with Stripe Connect
sections.body: Payouts need the payment gateway and the Connect return and refresh addresses configured.
items: Create account link starts or resumes Stripe Express onboarding for the signed-in user's own profile and returns the page to open.
Refresh account status pulls the charges-enabled, payouts-enabled, and details-submitted flags from Stripe onto the profile.
When an order's escrow is released, the provider's share is transferred to this account if one exists.
Deleting a profile is a soft delete and it can be restored; a deleted profile is not used for Connect.
